definition: A separation process in which a biochemical mixture is divided into distinct cellular or molecular fractions.
manuscriptExample: Subcellular fractionation confirmed nuclear translocation of the transcription factor upon ligand stimulation.
conferenceExample: The reviewer questioned whether cytosolic contamination was present in the nuclear membrane fraction.

definition: The accuracy and exactness with which biological processes like DNA replication or translation copy genetic code.
manuscriptExample: High-fidelity polymerases were utilized to minimize PCR-induced error rates during library preparation.
conferenceExample: We addressed Reviewer 2's query regarding transcriptional fidelity under cellular stress conditions.
